story_type: capsized boat, people in the water
hook: Their boat flipped three miles out, with a four-year-old aboard.
narration: This four year old was in the ocean, three miles off the North Carolina coast.
Their twenty two foot boat had flipped over with four adults and the child aboard.
A Coast Guard boat crew from Wrightsville Beach reached them and threw a line.
Rescuers reach and throw before they ever go in, [short pause] so nobody else ends up in the water.
Then the crew hauled them in, one at a time, through the chop.
outcome: The Wrightsville Beach crew pulled all five of them out of the water.
title: Boat flipped with a 4-year-old aboard
description:
A Coast Guard Station Wrightsville Beach boat crew pulled four adults and a 4-year-old from the water after their 22-foot boat capsized about three miles off Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina, on June 28, 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Dylan Hall, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/535079/coast-guard-rescues-4-adults-1-child-water-near-masonboro-inlet-nc
